title: MimiKoth
description: A Koth plugin that has everything you need!
body:
# About MimiKoth
MimiKoth is a fully configurable KOTH (King of the Hill) plugin designed for Paper servers.

Originally, MimiKoth was developed exclusively for my own Minecraft network. The goal was to create a KOTH system that was flexible, performant, easy to configure, and capable of supporting different playstyles and server types. Over time, the plugin evolved far beyond its original purpose, gaining multiple game modes, advanced scheduling, database support, integrations, and many quality-of-life features.

Although the network it was originally created for is no longer online, I decided to continue developing and releasing MimiKoth for the community. Instead of letting the project disappear, I wanted server owners and developers to benefit from the work that had already been invested into it.

Today, MimiKoth aims to provide a modern and highly customizable KOTH experience while remaining lightweight, reliable, and easy to use. Whether you're running a small community server or a large network, the plugin is designed to adapt to your needs through extensive configuration options and modular features.

**[https://github.com/casqidev/MimiKoth/wiki](https://github.com/casqidev/MimiKoth/wiki)**

# Compatible Versions
Supported target:

- Paper 1.20 - 1.26.x
(For now it is only for paper, support for other software will be added soon)

# Features
- Designed exclusively for Paper servers.
- Supports Paper 1.20.x through the latest supported versions.
- Intended long-term compatibility with future Paper releases.
- Multiple KOTH game modes:
  - Capture
  - King
  - Points
- Unlimited KOTH arenas.
- Individual configuration files for every KOTH.
- Region selection wand.
- Built-in scheduler system.
- Fully configurable rewards.
- Fully configurable points system.
- Optional points shop.
- Optional scoreboard system.
- Optional BossBar support.
- Optional native TextDisplay holograms.
- DiscordSRV integration.
- PlaceholderAPI support.
- Multiple storage providers:
  - YAML
  - SQLite
  - MySQL
  - MariaDB
- Public developer API.
- Custom Bukkit events.
- bStats metrics integration.
- Modular architecture with optional features.
- Extensive configuration options.
- Performance-focused design.
- Suitable for both small servers and large networks.

## Commands
MimiKoth has a series of commands and permissions, so that certain people can do all kinds of things. It has a wide variety of commands, thus allowing great administration of the plugin when wanting to perform certain actions.

- `/koth help` - Shows command help.
- `/koth wand` - Gives the selection wand.
- `/koth create <name>` - Creates a KOTH from the current selection.
- `/koth move <name>` - Moves an existing KOTH to the current selection.
- `/koth tp <name>` - Teleports to a KOTH.
- `/koth delete <name>` - Deletes a KOTH.
- `/koth start <name>` - Starts a KOTH.
- `/koth stop <name>` - Stops a KOTH.
- `/koth stopall` - Stops all KOTHs.
- `/koth time <name>` - Shows active or scheduled time for a KOTH.
- `/koth stats` - Opens the player stats menu.
- `/koth list` - Lists all KOTHs.
- `/koth points` - Shows the player's KOTH points.
- `/koth points give <player> <amount>` - Gives KOTH points.
- `/koth points take <player> <amount>` - Removes KOTH points.
- `/koth points clear <player>` - Clears KOTH points.
- `/koth shop` - Opens the KOTH shop.
- `/koth reload` - Reloads configuration files.

## Permissions

- `mimikoths.admin` - Access to admin commands.
- `mimikoths.use` - Access to basic player commands.
